note.self: Germany: 27+ month queue for self-funded Master's. Italy: VFS via Universitaly, summer rush. Hungary: D visa at the embassy's Dhaka Office (no trip to Delhi), fairly quick. France: Campus France, 3 interviews, about 3 months.
note.sch: German-gov / EU-funded scholars skip Germany's queue. Stipendium Hungaricum and Eiffel holders get priority handling.

note.self: Germany: no tuition but €11,904 blocked. Italy: income-based fees, cheap rent, €10,180/yr proof of funds. Hungary: €3–5k fees, cheapest living. France: about €3,950/yr fees and €877.50/month (€10,530/yr) proof of funds.
note.sch: Erasmus €1,400/month, DAAD ~€992, Eiffel ~€1,181. Hungary's stipend (HUF 43,700 ≈ €110) covers little beyond the dorm.

note.self: Italy's DSU is income-based, so most Bangladeshi families qualify. Stipendium Hungaricum is open to Bangladesh with ministry nomination. German and French awards are few and competitive.
note.sch: Scenario assumes you already hold the award.

note.self: Germany: spouse visa with A1 German and funds. Italy: ~€10,650/yr income + housing. Hungary: no family reunification for study permits. France: spouse needs a separate visitor visa, no work.
note.sch: Same rules; a stipend helps show funds in Germany and Italy.

note.self: Germany: 18-month job-search permit, Frankfurt. France: 1-year post-study permit, Paris finance. Italy: 9–12 months. Hungary: small market, low pay.
Germany: Frankfurt, Magdeburg, FU Berlin. Italy: Bologna, Turin, Milan, Pavia. Hungary: Corvinus, Debrecen. France: strong but many English finance MSc are at fee-charging schools.
German 1.79 clears most cut-offs. Italian pre-evaluation and Hungarian entrance interviews are broader. French public Master's are selective.
All teach in English; part-time jobs and paperwork need the local language, most of all in France.

self.headline: Self-funded, Italy is your best 2027 route. Apply to Stipendium Hungaricum and Erasmus Mundus in parallel; Germany's Dhaka visa queue (27+ months) blocks a self-funded start.

routes.title: Italy with a DSU regional grant
routes.detail: Apply Jan–Apr 2027, pre-enrol on Universitaly. DSU pays up to about €8,246/year plus a fee waiver if your family's income qualifies.

routes.title: Erasmus Mundus + Stipendium Hungaricum, in parallel
routes.detail: Both are free to apply and close in January. Hungary is fully funded, but your wife can't join on family reunification while you study.

routes.title: Germany, self-funded
routes.detail: Admission in mid-2027 means a visa appointment around late 2029. Keep Germany for an award or a job move after an EU degree.

next: IELTS is on 5 Dec (14 days). Today: mock test, Reading passage 3 + full Listening (60 min). Nothing ticked done since 20 Oct, so one session today restarts your streak.
Get the NSU English-medium letter now: EPOG/GLOBAL COOP (27 Jan), Debrecen and BME (Hungary) and Bologna QF accept it; Tor Vergata and Turin check English at the interview.
Stipendium Hungaricum 2027/28 call still not out (expected deadline 15 Jan); Corvinus MSc Finance early-bird deadline 20 Jan 2027.
Erasmus Mundus: shortlist 3 by 15 Dec; GrEnFIn 7 Jan, GLOCAL 14 Jan, EPOG or GLOBAL COOP 27 Jan.

sch.headline: With an EU- or government-funded award, Germany moves to first, France second: both skip the queue and have the stronger job markets.

routes.title: Germany on Erasmus / DAAD
routes.detail: Funded scholars are processed right after Consular Services Portal registration. Arrive Oct 2027.

routes.title: France on Eiffel, or Italy on Erasmus
routes.detail: Eiffel covers ~€1,181/month and fees; universities nominate you, usually by January.

routes.title: Hungary on Stipendium Hungaricum
routes.detail: Fees and dorm covered, but the stipend is small and your wife can't join on family reunification.

next: Eiffel via Paris-Saclay: email one Master's coordinator by 26 Nov (5 days); results by 7 Dec.
Pick up to 3 Erasmus Mundus: GrEnFIn 7 Jan, GLOCAL 14 Jan, EPOG or GLOBAL COOP 27 Jan (same portal). EMLE (31 Dec) only if law-economics appeals.
Études en France: Master's deadline 15 Jan 2027; Eiffel files from universities by 6 Jan.
Keep the Italy and Hungary applications running until an award letter arrives.

analysis.changeNote: Hungary and France added. Italy leads if self-funded; Germany leads with a scholarship.

signals.title: Dhaka: self-funded Master's visas wait more than 27 months
signals.detail: The German Embassy says the wait for students without a German or EU scholarship is more than 27 months and is not expected to fall. Registration opens only after admission.

signals.title: German-gov or EU-funded scholars skip the queue
signals.detail: Scholarship applicants are processed right after CSP registration. Only German-government or EU-funded awards (DAAD, Erasmus Mundus) count.

signals.title: Blocked account stays at €11,904 (€992/month)
signals.detail: Minimum balance for the student visa, per the Dhaka embassy page. About 16.7 lakh BDT at 140.

signals.title: Bavaria: more universities may charge non-EU fees
signals.detail: TUM charges €4,000–6,000 per semester for Master's; one tracker says FAU starts from summer 2027. Baden-Württemberg charges €1,500. Other states stay free.

signals.title: Italy: VFS emails Universitaly registrants for visa appointments
signals.detail: No separate booking. Deadline for 2026/27 applications is 30 Nov 2026. A CIMEA certificate or Declaration of Value is required; relatives may guarantee funds.

signals.title: Italian embassy promises to clear ~20,000 pending Bangladeshi visas
signals.detail: Mostly work visas, but it strains the same embassy. Expect slow summer appointments; register on Universitaly early.

signals.title: DSU 2026/27 top grant about €8,246/year (ER.GO, Padova)
signals.detail: Income-based; non-EU students compete on equal terms using an ISEE parificato. 2027/28 calls expected from June 2027.

signals.title: Italy spouse reunification: about €10,652/year income
signals.detail: Based on the 2026 social allowance (€7,101) plus 50%. Also needs housing and a residence permit valid for at least a year.

signals.title: Invest Your Talent in Italy: next call expected early 2027
signals.detail: Last round ran 20 Apr – 11 May 2026. Needs B2 English, birth on/after 1 Jan 2000; can't be combined with DSU.

signals.title: Stipendium Hungaricum 2027/28: deadline expected 15 Jan 2027
signals.detail: The official call isn't out yet; last year's closed 15 Jan at 14:00 CET. Apply on DreamApply and get nominated by Bangladesh's Ministry of Education.

signals.title: Stipendium Hungaricum pays HUF 43,700/month + dorm
signals.detail: Tuition is free and you get a dorm place or HUF 40,000/month for housing. The cash stipend is small, so plan your own living money.

signals.title: Hungary: no family reunification for study permits
signals.detail: Hungary's immigration authority says a student's family members 'shall not be granted a residence permit for the purpose of family reunification' (only exception: a child born in Hungary). Students may work up to 30 hours a week.

signals.title: France: non-EU Master's fees about €3,950/yr; exemptions capped
signals.detail: A May 2026 decree limits universities to exempting 30% of non-EU students in 2026/27, falling to 20%. Eiffel and French-government scholars pay nothing.

signals.title: France: the student visa doesn't cover your wife
signals.detail: Campus France Bangladesh says the student visa is for the student only; a spouse applies separately as a long-stay visitor and can't work.

signals.title: France: student-visa funds now €877.50 a month (was €615)
signals.detail: The French government's service-public page now sets the minimum at €877.50/month, about €10,530 (14.7 lakh BDT) a year, slightly above Italy's €10,180. France's cost score stays at 6; the cost note now shows the figure.

signals.title: Erasmus Mundus 2027 cycle is open: most deadlines Dec – Jan
signals.detail: Up to 3 applications. €1,400/month plus fees and travel. A win also clears the German visa queue.

signals.title: Finland bill: students' families wait 1 year before applying
signals.detail: Proposed to start 5 Apr 2027. With €10–12k fees, it's why Finland isn't in your top four.

signals.title: Eiffel: universities set internal deadlines before 6 Jan (Paris-Saclay: 26 Nov)
signals.detail: Campus France takes files until 6 Jan 2027, but a French university must nominate you and sets its own earlier date. Paris-Saclay's is 26 Nov 2026.

signals.title: Pavia MSc Finance: Universitaly windows 12-18 Nov, final 24 May 2027
signals.detail: Pavia lists three pre-enrolment windows for 2027/28 (the later two printed with 2026 dates, likely a typo for 2027). The final deadline for non-restricted programmes is 24 May 2027, so IELTS on 5 Dec still fits.

signals.title: Padua: first call for 2027/28 closes 15 Nov; second call 1 Dec – 1 Mar
signals.detail: English-taught Master's such as Accounting, Finance & Business Consulting take non-EU applicants abroad in Call One and Call Two only. Application fee €60, English B2.

signals.title: Padua excellence scholarship: €8,000/year plus fee exemption, automatic
signals.detail: Up to 76 awards for English-taught degrees with no separate form, mainly for first-call applicants. The page still shows the 2026/27 call; new calls are due in November 2026.

signals.title: France: Études en France Master's deadline from Bangladesh is 15 Jan 2027
signals.detail: Campus France Bangladesh opened the campaign on 1 Oct 2026; the fee is BDT 12,170. The page says programme choices lock after 18 Nov 2026, so confirm whether that covers Master's files.

signals.title: Eiffel 2027: universities file by 6 Jan 2027; results from 12 Apr
signals.detail: Master's candidates must be 29 or younger, and only the French institution can submit, so its internal deadline comes earlier.

signals.title: Italy study visa: proof of funds is €10,179.85 a year
signals.detail: Italian embassy pages give €10,179.85/year as the minimum for 2026/27 and 2027/28 (about BDT 14.25 lakh), up from about €7,000 in 2025. Still below Germany's €11,904, so Italy's cost score stays; the cost note now shows the figure.

signals.title: Eiffel: Toulouse School of Management's internal deadline is 16 Nov
signals.detail: TSM (Univ. Toulouse Capitole) takes Eiffel files only from 26 Oct to 16 Nov 2026 and asks for an English test certificate; the award is €1,200/month. Paris-Saclay's date stays 26 Nov.

signals.title: Bologna Quantitative Finance takes an English-taught degree as B2 proof
signals.detail: The programme's enrolment page accepts a degree taught completely in English instead of IELTS and requires no GRE/GMAT. The 2027/28 call is not published yet.

signals.title: Turin Quantitative Finance checks English at the interview, no certificate listed
signals.detail: The University of Turin's application page says B2 English is verified during the admission interview. It lists tuition of €2,800/year before income-based reductions and a €70 fee; 2027/28 is not open yet.

signals.title: Milan's Finance and Economics MSc never accepts English-medium letters
signals.detail: The MEF enrolment page says medium-of-instruction letters are never accepted, even from fully English-taught degrees, so it needs IELTS or the university's SLAM test. The 2027/28 call is not published; last cycle ran 22 Jan – 30 Apr.

signals.title: GrEnFIn 2027/28: GRE/GMAT optional, deadline 7 Jan 2027
signals.detail: Bologna's official notice scores GRE/GMAT as optional (max 10 of 100 points), so you can apply without it. It needs an English certificate, so the 5 Dec IELTS result is your proof.

signals.title: GLOCAL Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline 14 Jan 2027
signals.detail: Scholarship applications for all tracks close 14 Jan 2027, 13:00 UK time, and English proof must be in by then. Results come in April 2027.

signals.title: Ca' Foscari finance MA: €2,300/yr, 2027/28 applications from December
signals.detail: English-taught MA Economics, Finance and Sustainability needs a 70% CGPA and an online test. Its €10,000 Honours Scholarship needs 85% GPA, above your ~80%.

signals.title: Hungary: students may work up to 30 hours a week during term
signals.detail: The Immigration Office factsheet allows up to 30 hours a week while studying and full-time work for 90 days a year outside term. Family reunification for students is still not allowed.

signals.title: Two Hungarian SH finance options don't need IELTS
signals.detail: Debrecen's MSc International Economy and Business accepts an English-medium certificate; Corvinus MSc Finance tests English in its own entrance exam. The 2027/28 Stipendium Hungaricum call is still not published.

signals.title: Dhaka: student visas go digital on 1 Jan 2027; old waiting list ends
signals.detail: From 1 Jan 2027 Bachelor's and Master's students apply online in the Consular Services Portal; VFS pre-checks files and visits are mainly for biometrics and fees. The old appointment waiting list closes at the end of 2026, so everyone, including people already on it, must open a new account and apply again. The embassy has not said the 27+ month wait gets shorter.

signals.title: BME Budapest MSc Finance: Stipendium Hungaricum option that accepts an MOI letter
signals.detail: BME's English-taught MSc Finance takes a BBA Finance, accepts a Medium of Instruction certificate as B2 proof and admits by online test and interview. Self-funded it costs €2,200 a semester; the 2027/28 SH call is still not published.

signals.title: Paris-Saclay Eiffel: contact a coordinator by 26 Nov, results by 7 Dec
signals.detail: Re-checked on the official page: you email the coordinator of one Master's by 26 Nov 2026 and hear by 7 Dec. Preselected or not, the normal Master's application opens in February 2027.

signals.title: Corvinus MSc Finance 2027/28 is open: early-bird deadline 20 Jan 2027
signals.detail: Corvinus's official application page lists a discounted pre-deadline of 20 Jan 2027 and a final deadline of 12 Aug 2027, at €4,000 a semester. It sets no English certificate; English is tested in its own online entrance exam.

signals.title: Szeged MA International Economy and Business is a third SH finance-leaning option
signals.detail: The official SH portal lists this 4-semester English MA with finance and accounting courses for economics/business graduates; it asks for IELTS 6.0 and doesn't mention an MOI letter. Not open yet; 2027/28 SH call still unpublished.

signals.title: Erasmus Mundus DEAI (data/AI): grant deadline 11 Jan 2027
signals.detail: Official page: grant applications close 11 Jan 2027 at 12:00 GMT, IELTS 5.5 accepted. Its selection score rewards computer-science credits, so a BBA Finance is a long shot.

signals.title: German visa: embassy page and 15 Nov news disagree on re-registering
signals.detail: The embassy page (still dated 4 Jun 2026) says people on the old list need not re-register; Prothom Alo's 15 Nov report says everyone must reapply in the portal from 1 Jan 2027. It only matters once you hold an admission letter; re-check in January.

signals.title: New Erasmus Mundus GLOBAL COOP opens on EPOG's portal, deadline 27 Jan 2027
signals.detail: The official EPOG application platform lists GLOBAL COOP (economic policies for new global cooperation) for 2027-2029 beside EPOG-JM, closing 27 Jan 2027 at 13:00 Paris. Listings say one track covers the international monetary and financial system.

signals.title: Erasmus Mundus EMLE: non-European deadline 31 Dec 2026, IELTS 7.0
signals.detail: The official EMLE page for 2027/28 sets 31 Dec 2026 for non-Europeans, needs 240 ECTS and IELTS 7.0 (6.0 per band), and says an English-medium degree does not exempt you. Law and economics, so a weak fit for a finance degree.

signals.title: Hungary: student D visas are handled by the embassy's Dhaka Office
signals.detail: The Hungarian Embassy in New Delhi says its Dhaka Office receives D-visa cases, booked by email, so you would not need to travel to India. The visa note in the Compass now says this; the score stays at 7.

signals.title: Tor Vergata MSc Finance and Banking: English checked at interview, no GRE
signals.detail: The Rome programme's official FAQ says no English certificate is needed, and English is checked at the online interview. It sets an 80% minimum GPA and charges income-based fees of about €200–400 a month. The 2027/28 call is not out yet.

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus EPOG (economic policies, finance track)
picks.why: German and French partners, so a win can mean Germany without the visa queue.

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus GrEnFIn (energy markets and finance)
picks.why: Finance track via Bologna, Munich and Paris; GRE optional, but it needs an IELTS-type certificate by 7 Jan.

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus catalogue: finance, data, management
picks.why: Finish a shortlist of 3 by this date.

picks.name: University of Bologna: MSc Quantitative Finance
picks.funding: Income-based fees; ER.GO DSU up to ~€8,246/yr
picks.why: English-taught; non-EU windows usually Mar–May.

picks.name: University of Turin: Quantitative Finance and Insurance
picks.funding: Listed €2,800/yr before income-based reductions; EDISU DSU
picks.why: English B2 is checked at the interview with no certificate listed; Turin is cheaper than Milan.

picks.name: University of Milan: Finance and Economics (MEF)
picks.why: Does not accept English-medium letters (IELTS or its SLAM test needed); 2027/28 call not out, last cycle's non-EU window was 22 Jan – 30 Apr.

picks.name: University of Pavia: MSc Finance
picks.why: Small city, lower rent, near Milan's finance jobs; Universitaly windows from 12 Nov 2026, final 24 May 2027; English B2 and interview.

picks.name: DSU regional grant (ER.GO, ESU Padova, EDISU …)
picks.why: Calls open around June 2027; start the legalised family income papers in spring.

picks.name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
picks.why: Next call expected early 2027; check the country list and age limit.

picks.name: Stipendium Hungaricum (Hungarian government)
picks.why: Bangladesh is a partner country; you also need the Ministry of Education's nomination.

picks.name: Corvinus University of Budapest: MSc Finance
picks.why: Hungary's top business school; pick it as one of your two SH choices.

picks.name: University of Debrecen: business and finance Master's
picks.why: Large international intake and a South Asia office.

picks.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (Master's)
picks.why: Your French university nominates you and must file by 6 Jan 2027; ask each programme for its earlier internal deadline.

picks.name: Campus France Bangladesh: Études en France
picks.why: Every French application from Bangladesh goes through this portal and its interview.

picks.name: Goethe Univ. Frankfurt: MSc Money, Macro and Finance
picks.why: Realistic for 2027 only with a funded scholarship because of the visa queue.

picks.name: Univ. of Magdeburg: International Management and Finance
picks.why: Good fit for your grades; pair it with an Erasmus or DAAD award.

picks.name: Freie Universität Berlin: MSc Finance
picks.why: Berlin jobs but high rent. Confirm the 2027 date.

picks.name: DAAD database: English, tuition-free finance MSc
picks.funding: No tuition outside Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg
picks.why: Target date for the German shortlist.

picks.name: University of Padua: MSc Accounting, Finance & Business Consulting
picks.funding: €2,950/yr before income-based cuts; excellence scholarship or Veneto DSU possible
picks.why: Finance-focused and English-taught; Call Two (1 Dec – 1 Mar) falls after your IELTS result.

picks.name: Padua International Excellence Scholarship
picks.why: Automatic when you apply to an English-taught Padua degree, but mostly awarded in the first call closing 15 Nov.

picks.name: Eiffel via Toulouse School of Management (internal call)
picks.why: Closes in 4 days and wants an English certificate before your IELTS, so only worth it if TSM accepts your NSU English-medium letter.

picks.name: Italy study visa: proof of funds €10,179.85/year
picks.funding: Not a scholarship: the minimum you must show
picks.why: About 14.25 lakh BDT a year fits inside your 15–25 lakh budget, and a DSU grant can count toward it.

picks.name: Eiffel via Université Paris-Saclay (internal call)
picks.funding: Eiffel: monthly allowance + travel + insurance; no fees
picks.why: Covers economics and management Master's and asks for no English test in the Eiffel file, but it is very competitive at CGPA 3.21.

picks.name: Ca' Foscari Venice: MA Economics, Finance and Sustainability
picks.why: English-taught finance MA whose 70% CGPA bar you clear; 2027/28 applications open from December.

picks.name: University of Debrecen: MSc International Economy and Business
picks.funding: Stipendium Hungaricum eligible: tuition + stipend + dorm
picks.why: Accepts your NSU English-medium certificate instead of IELTS and takes BBA graduates; a solid second SH choice next to Corvinus.

picks.name: BME Budapest: MSc Finance
picks.why: Takes your BBA Finance and NSU English-medium letter instead of IELTS; a third SH finance choice next to Corvinus and Debrecen.

picks.name: France student visa: proof of funds €877.50/month
picks.funding: Not a scholarship: the minimum you must show
picks.why: About 14.7 lakh BDT a year sits inside your 15–25 lakh budget but leaves little for France's ~€3,950 fees unless Eiffel pays.

picks.name: University of Szeged: MA International Economy and Business
picks.why: Backup SH choice with finance and accounting courses that takes a BBA; needs your IELTS (6.0).

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus DEAI (Data Engineering and AI)
picks.why: A real data route, but scoring favours computer-science credits, so only use a slot on it if you want pure data/AI.

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus GLOBAL COOP (economic policies, international finance track)
picks.why: An economics EM with an international monetary and finance track, on the same portal and date as EPOG, so it costs little extra effort.

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus EMLE (law and economics)
picks.funding: EM scholarship up to €1,400/month (about 15 a year)
picks.why: Earliest EM deadline still open to you, but it is law and economics and needs IELTS 7.0 with no MOI exemption.

picks.name: Tor Vergata (Rome): MSc Finance and Banking
picks.funding: Public; fees about €200–400/month by income; LazioDisco grant possible
picks.why: A finance MSc that needs no IELTS or GRE: English is checked at the interview, and your BBA Finance meets the maths/economics/statistics prerequisites.
